scene.speaker: oliver
scene.bubble: When I'm sad, I play my guitar. When Kili is sad, he eats seven biscuits. Everyone has their own medicine!
scene.intro: When I'm sad, I play my guitar, says Oliver. When I'm happy, I play it louder — much louder. When Kili is angry, he sits on the roof and refuses to speak to anybody for hours. When Ingrid is worried, she makes lists; when Maya is surprised, she takes notes instead of screaming. And when everybody is proud, they celebrate together by the sea. What do YOU do when you're sad or happy? Say it with when!

data.voice_note: Voces: Oliver (preguntando al equipo) y Kili (con respuestas dulces).
data.script: Oliver: Team question: what do you do when you're sad? … Oliver: Ingrid says she swims. The water washes the sadness away, she says. … Oliver: Diego watches old funny films and laughs until his stomach hurts. … Oliver: Maya looks at the stars with her telescope. The sky is big, the problems are small. … Oliver: Me? I play slow songs on my guitar until they become happy songs. … Oliver: And Kili… Kili eats exactly seven biscuits and then hugs somebody. … Oliver: A hug from a condor fixes almost everything!

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the school courtyard? The boy with red hair and a yellow shirt. … Maya: That is Oliver. Oliver is singing. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the girl in the green shirt with a magnifying glass? … Maya: That is Maya. Look, Maya is looking at something very small. … Diego: And who is the boy with very short hair and a white and green shirt? … Maya: That is Tino. Look, Tino is playing hockey. … Diego: And who is the girl with fair hair and a dark blue jacket? … Maya: That is Ingrid. Look, Ingrid is reading the plan for the day.
